fullDescription: A dark glassmorphism form landing page: a frosted, focus-aware account form floating over drifting aqua-and-magenta aurora orbs, with gradient CTAs, a feature grid, and login/checkout/error form showcases.

structured.summary: A dark glassmorphism marketing-and-form landing page ("Lumen — Forms that feel like glass") on a near-black #0b0f14 ground. A frosted, focus-aware account form floats in the hero over drifting aurora orbs (aqua #2dd4bf + magenta #e879f9), paired with a left-side value prop. Below: a 6-card feature grid, a 3-up form showcase (login / card checkout / feedback-error states), a prompt-library split, a centered pricing CTA band, and a slim footer. Frosted blur, a faint masked grid, gradient text, and a teal→sky→magenta gradient CTA carry the system end to end.

style.description: Premium dark glassmorphism: near-black ink ground, frosted translucent surfaces with backdrop-blur and a 1px white hairline, neon aqua-to-magenta aurora gradients, and a focus-glow accent system. Display headings in Space Grotesk, body in Inter. No hard shadows in the diffuse sense — light is carried by blur, soft inner top highlights, and colored glows.
style.prompt: Design a dark glassmorphism landing page. Background: solid ink #0b0f14, body text #e7ecf2. Two brand accents drive everything: aqua #2dd4bf (with #5eead4 light and #7dd3fc sky as a tertiary) and magenta #e879f9 (with #f5d0fe light). Typography: display/headings use 'Space Grotesk' 600-700 with tight tracking; body/UI uses 'Inter' 400-600; antialiased, optimizeLegibility. Surfaces are frosted glass — translucent white fills (linear-gradient 150deg from rgba(255,255,255,0.10) to 0.02), backdrop-filter blur(28px) saturate(140%), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.14), and a layered shadow '0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18)'; a lighter 'glass-soft' variant uses rgba(255,255,255,0.045) fill, blur(16px), 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border. Hairline dividers are rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Behind glass, place blurred aurora orbs (radial-gradient aqua and magenta, border-radius 9999px, filter blur(34-50px)) that slowly drift via keyframe float (17-20s ease-in-out). Headlines use a gradient-clip text 'linear-gradient(100deg,#2dd4bf 0%,#7dd3fc 38%,#e879f9 100%)' on the emphasized word. Primary CTA is a pill/rounded button with 'linear-gradient(100deg,#2dd4bf,#34d3c4 50%,#e879f9 140%)', dark ink text #04110f, glow shadow '0 12px 40px -12px rgba(45,212,191,0.6)' + inset top highlight, lifting -2px on hover. Eyebrow tags are aqua-tinted pills: bg rgba(45,212,191,0.10), 1px rgba(45,212,191,0.28) border, #5eead4 text. Keep generous whitespace, rounded-2xl/3xl radii, and a calm, high-end feel.

layout_and_structure.description: Single-column scrolling page on a max-w-7xl (1280px) centered container with px-6/lg:px-8 gutters. Fixed translucent nav, then a 2-column hero (copy left, glass form right) over a masked grid + radial wash, a trust logo strip, a 3-col feature grid, a 3-col showcase, a 5/7 prompt-library split, a centered pricing band, and a footer. Sections separated by top hairline borders and ~py-24/28 rhythm. Everything reflows to a single column under lg; mobile centers the hero copy and stacks the form below.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top nav, full-width, z-50, translucent bg rgba(11,15,20,0.62) with backdrop-blur(18px) saturate(140%) and a bottom hairline. Inside a max-w-7xl row, h-16: left = brand lockup (an 8x8 rounded-lg chip filled 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2dd4bf,#e879f9)' holding a ph:diamonds-four-fill ink icon, plus 'Lumen' in Space Grotesk 600); center (md+ only) = nav links Features / Showcase / Prompt Library / Pricing in white/65 with hover:white; right = a 'Sign in' text link (sm+) and a gradient 'Start free' pill CTA with a ph:arrow-right-bold.

Full-bleed hero, pt-28/lg:pt-36, overflow-hidden. Background layers: a deep radial wash (aqua top-center + magenta bottom-right, both fading to transparent) and a faint grid (1px white/0.035 lines on 56px cells) radially masked so it fades at the edges. Content is a 2-col grid (lg:grid-cols-2). LEFT: an aqua eyebrow tag 'Form Design, generated from a prompt' with ph:sparkle-fill; an h1 in Space Grotesk ~64px/700 'Forms that feel like glass.' with 'glass.' in gradient-clip text; a white/65 lead paragraph (max-w-md); a button row = gradient CTA 'Generate a form' (ph:magic-wand-fill) + a glass-soft pill 'See the canvas' (ph:play-circle-fill); and two check rows (ph:check-circle-fill in aqua) 'Tailwind export' / 'WCAG focus states'. On lg the copy is left-aligned; below lg it centers.

RIGHT side of hero: a frosted glass form card, max-w-[420px], rounded-3xl, p-7/8, z-10, with three blurred aurora orbs bleeding behind it (a 280px aqua top-left, a 300px magenta bottom-right, a 160px aqua mid-right at lower opacity), each slowly drifting. Card header: 'Create account' (Space Grotesk 600, text-2xl) plus a glass-soft 'AI draft' chip (aqua text, ph:sparkle-fill). Subtext white/55 'Live preview generated from your prompt.' Fields use the dark glass field style (bg rgba(9,13,18,0.55), 1px white/0.10 border): an Email input with a ph:envelope-simple leading icon; a Password input with a ph:lock-simple leading icon, a ph:eye trailing toggle, and a 4-segment strength meter (two aqua, one magenta, one white/12) labeled 'Good'; a custom checkbox row (a gradient-filled rounded check w/ ph:check-bold) 'Email me product tips, no spam.' Full-width gradient CTA 'Create account'. An 'or continue with' hairline divider, then a 2-col grid of glass-soft social buttons (Google logos:google-icon, GitHub ph:github-logo-fill).

Below the hero grid, a top-hairline strip: a centered uppercase white/65 micro-label 'Trusted by design teams shipping fast' (tracking-[0.2em]), then a wrapping row of 5 muted wordmark logos (Northwind, Orbit, Halcyon, Voltage, Forma), each a Space Grotesk label with a leading phosphor icon (ph:orange-slice-fill, ph:planet-fill, ph:hexagon-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:cube-fill).

Section 'Why Lumen' with a faint aqua radial wash top-left. Eyebrow tag (ph:stack-fill), an h2 'Every detail a great form needs, by default.' with 'by default.' in gradient text, and a white/60 lead. Then a responsive grid (1/sm:2/lg:3) of 6 glass-soft cards, each: an 11x11 rounded-xl tinted icon chip (alternating aqua / magenta / sky tints with matching 0.28 borders), a Space Grotesk lg title, and a white/55 description. Cards: Focus-aware fields (ph:cursor-click-fill), Validation built in (ph:shield-check-fill), Responsive out of the box (ph:devices-fill), Clean Tailwind export (ph:code-fill), Infinite canvas (ph:infinity-fill), Theme tokens (ph:palette-fill). Cards brighten their border on hover.

Full-bleed 'One prompt, many forms' section with a vertical aqua gradient wash and two faint corner orbs. Centered header: eyebrow tag (ph:squares-four-fill), h2 'From sign-in to checkout, all glass.' (gradient 'all glass.'), white/60 lead. Then a 3-col grid (lg) of full 'glass' (heavier) cards, each prefaced by a tiny terminal-style prompt label (ph:terminal-window-fill): (1) 'a minimal login' — Welcome back, Email + Password fields, gradient 'Sign in'. (2) 'a card checkout' — Payment, a Card-number field shown in the FOCUSED state (aqua border + aqua glow ring, ph:credit-card-fill trailing icon), Expiry + CVC in a 2-col row, gradient 'Pay $29.00'. (3) 'a feedback form' — Tell us more, an Email field in the ERROR state (red #f87171 border + red glow + a ph:warning-circle-fill 'Enter a valid email' message in #fca5a5), a Message textarea, and a glass-soft 'Send feedback'. Use these as the canonical focus / error state references.

Top-hairline section, a 12-col grid: LEFT (col-span-5) = eyebrow tag (ph:books-fill), h2 'Start from a prompt that already works.' (gradient 'already works.'), white/60 lead, and an aqua 'Explore the library' link with a ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges right on hover. RIGHT (col-span-7) = a 2-col grid of 4 glass-soft prompt cards, each with a leading phosphor icon (ph:sign-in-fill, ph:credit-card-fill, ph:user-circle-plus-fill, ph:gear-fill) + a 'copy' tag top-right, and a quoted example form prompt as the body; cards tint their border aqua or magenta on hover.

prompts.prompt: Full-bleed centered band (max-w-4xl) over a magenta-bottom + aqua-top radial wash. A big h2 'Ship the form, not the busywork.' (Space Grotesk up to 5xl/700, 'not the busywork.' in gradient text), a white/60 supporting line, a centered button row = gradient pill 'Start designing free' (ph:arrow-right-bold) + glass-soft pill 'Talk to us', and a white/65 reassurance line 'Free forever for solo builders. Pro from $19/mo.'

Top-hairline footer, max-w-7xl, py-12: a row (stacks on mobile, justified on md) with the Lumen brand lockup, a set of text links (Features / Library / Pricing / Docs in white/65 hover:white), and 3 social icon links (ph:x-logo-fill, ph:github-logo-fill, ph:discord-logo-fill). Below, a small white/65 line '© 2026 Lumen Design. Forms that feel like glass.'

special_ui_components.prompt: Frosted glass card: translucent white gradient fill + backdrop-blur(28px) saturate(140%) + 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) border + layered drop shadow and inset top highlight; a lighter 'glass-soft' variant for secondary surfaces and buttons.

Focus-aware form field: dark glass fill rgba(9,13,18,0.55), 1px white/0.10 border, placeholder white/62; on focus the border turns aqua rgba(45,212,191,0.85) with a 3px aqua ring + 28px aqua glow (a magenta variant uses #e879f9 instead). Card-checkout field demonstrates the focused state; feedback field demonstrates a red error state.

Drifting aurora orbs: large blurred radial-gradient circles (aqua and magenta) animated with two slow keyframe drifts (auroraDrift 17s / auroraDriftAlt 20s), placed behind glass surfaces to bleed colored light through the blur.
Gradient CTA: pill/rounded button filled 'linear-gradient(100deg,#2dd4bf,#34d3c4,#e879f9)' with dark ink text, aqua glow shadow + inset top highlight, lifting on hover.
Gradient-clip headline text: teal→sky→magenta linear-gradient clipped to the emphasized word in each heading.
Password strength meter: 4 equal segment bars (filled aqua, aqua, magenta, then an empty white/12) with a 'Good' label.
Custom gradient checkbox: an 18px rounded square filled with the aqua gradient holding a ph:check-bold tick.
Aqua eyebrow tag pill: rgba(45,212,191,0.10) bg, rgba(45,212,191,0.28) border, #5eead4 text, with a leading phosphor icon, used to label every section.
Masked background grid: 1px white/0.035 grid on 56px cells, radial-masked so it fades out toward the edges, used as hero texture.
Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icon set throughout, plus logos:google-icon for the social button.

structured.special_notes: Built with the Tailwind CDN; fonts loaded from Google Fonts (Inter + Space Grotesk); icons via Iconify (phosphor 'ph:*' family + 'logos:google-icon'). Tailwind theme extends colors ink:#0b0f14, aqua:#2dd4bf, magenta:#e879f9 and font families sans:Inter / display:'Space Grotesk'. The glassmorphism depends on backdrop-filter, so render on a non-white, textured ground (the aurora orbs + grid) for the frost to read. Honor reduced-motion by allowing the orb animations to pause. Form is non-submitting (onsubmit return false) — it's a design preview. Maintain WCAG-grade focus visibility (the 3px ring is intentional, not decorative). Reflows cleanly from 390px to 1440px: hero copy centers and the form stacks under lg, grids collapse to a single column.
